units.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
units.text: 1. Import, sale, rental or other unlawful use of copies of works or phonograms for the purpose of deriving income where those copies are counterfeit under Russian Federation legislation on copyright and related rights, or where the copies bear false information about their manufacturers, places of production or holders of copyright and related rights, as well as other infringement of copyright and related rights for the purpose of deriving income, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7.12

units.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; and thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five…”

units.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
units.text: 2. Unlawful use of an invention, utility model or industrial design, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code; disclosure of the substance of an invention, utility model or industrial design without the consent of the creator or applicant before information about it is officially published; appropriation of authorship; or coercion into co-authorship —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7.12

units.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles for citizens, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, and thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for legal entities.

units.text: 1. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit (open sheet) obtained in the prescribed manner, where those actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act, or in breach of the conditions laid down in the permit (open sheet) —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7.15

units.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; four thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; and forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork.
